messages:
Priya (Finance): FYI team: effective 2026-05-01 were changing billing behavior for short bursts and sustained high-usage. This affects burst overage credits, invoice finalization timing, and free credit phase-out for sustained heavy users. Please do not externalize until comms go live next week. :loudspeaker:

Tom (Ops): Quick ask: does this change rate limits or only billing semantics?

Priya (Finance): Only billing & invoice cadence. No rate-limit algorithm changes. Key points:
- Burst-exemption: one contiguous 24h burst per 7-day rolling window is exempt from overage billing (applied automatically).
- Sustained surcharge: applies if >50% reserved throughput OR >2x baseline for 7 consecutive days.
- Invoice finalization moves to the 3rd business day for clearer line-item reconciliation.

Jules (Product): How will customers see it in the invoice/dashboard?

Priya (Finance): Well add explicit line items: BURST_EXEMPTION_CREDIT and SUSTAINED_SURCHARGE with short notes. Also a dashboard banner at 70% quota to warn teams earlier.

Marta (Support): Will credits be auto-applied or manual? Need canned responses for AEs.

Priya (Finance): Burst credits auto-apply. Sustained surcharges contested go to billing ops for manual review within 5 business days. Sharing AE/support playbook tomorrow.

BillingBot: Heads-up: free credits phase-out will begin for accounts breaching sustained thresholds on 2026-06-01; prorated adjustments + 30-day notice applied. Rule id: FC-PHASE-2026.

Tom (Ops): Ok. Ops will add the soft-cap banner and an internal /quota-sim endpoint for testing this week.

Jules (Product): Rollout schedule?

Priya (Finance): Internal docs + help center: 2026-04-10. Early notices to impacted customers: 2026-04-20. Public FAQ & blog: 2026-04-30. Enforcement: burst-exemption effective 2026-05-01; credit phase-out 2026-06-01.

Marta (Support): Thanks. Please post the playbook and sample email templates in #support-channels when ready.
